final_answer:
Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. The other 23 pass the verification rule.

**Not currently verified**

1. **URS-EBR-009** (CONTROL, FRA-042). No test case verifies it. Its child spec CS-EBR-03 has no VERIFIES link to any test case, so there is no verification path at all.

2. **URS-EMS-014** (ALARM, FRA-027). The only verifying test case is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (alarm escalation to on-call), and its last passing execution is TX-0070 on SYS-EMS, dated 2026-01-20. That requirement is satisfied through CS-EMS-03, which CC-26-011 modifies (paging provider change, implemented 2026-03-16). The last pass predates the change, and no re-execution is recorded, so the verification is stale.

3. **URS-INC-004** (ALARM, FRA-004). The door-open alarm test TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on INC-03 (TX-0023, 2026-02-10, "Alarm activated at 142 s"). It has not been re-executed on INC-03 since. The linked deviation DEV-26-011 is closed, but CAPA-26-012 (replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04, due 2026-03-31) is still open and overdue. The other three incubators pass, but the requirement applies to every unit in SYS-INC, so it fails.

**Verified, with two caveats (not in the list above)**

- **URS-INC-001 and URS-INC-003** pass on all four incubators. CC-26-019 (door switch replacement on INC-03) is approved but not implemented, and has no implementation date. It cannot be tested for staleness yet, so re-check these two requirements once it is implemented.
- **URS-CRF-001 and URS-PRDG-002** are PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment systems with OQ passes but no PQ evidence. The currently-verified rule does not require PQ, so I counted them as verified, but the PQ-expected rule flags them as a gap.

The remaining verified requirements are URS-EBR-001, -002, -003, -007, -008; URS-EMS-010, -011, -012, -013; URS-LIMS-001 through -006; URS-LOVO-002; URS-PRDG-001; URS-ULT-001 and -002. For URS-ULT-001 and -002, the FRZ-80-02 change (CC-26-014, implemented 2026-04-23) was followed by passing re-executions on 2026-04-24 (TX-0091, TX-0092).

input.query:
WITH RECURSIVE hr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.tgt_id AS urs FROM pd.trace_link l JOIN pd.val_risk_item r ON r.ri_id=l.src_id
  WHERE l.link_type='ASSESSES' AND r.risk_class='HIGH'),
items(urs, item) AS (
  SELECT urs, urs FROM hr
  UNION
  SELECT i.urs, t.src_id FROM items i JOIN pd.trace_link t ON t.tgt_id=i.item AND t.link_type='TRACE'
),
vtc AS (
  SELECT i.urs, i.item, l.src_id AS tc_id FROM items i JOIN pd.trace_link l ON l.tgt_id=i.item AND l.link_type='VERIFIES'
),
units AS (
  SELECT h.urs, s.sys_id, s.sys_class, e.equip_id AS unit
  FROM hr h JOIN pd.val_spec_item s ON s.item_id=h.urs
  LEFT JOIN pd.equipment e ON e.sys_id=s.sys_id
),
ex AS (
  SELECT x.tc_id, x.target_id, x.exec_dt, x.result, x.exec_id,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY x.tc_id, x.target_id ORDER BY x.exec_dt DESC, x.exec_id DESC) rn
  FROM pd.val_test_exec x
)
SELECT v.urs, v.tc_id, tc.method, v.item, ex.target_id, ex.exec_dt, ex.result, ex.exec_id
FROM vtc v JOIN pd.val_test_case tc ON tc.tc_id=v.tc_id
LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.tc_id=v.tc_id AND ex.rn=1
ORDER BY 1,2,5;

Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. The other 23 pass the verification rule.

**Not currently verified**

1. **URS-EBR-009** (CONTROL, FRA-042). No test case verifies it. Its child spec CS-EBR-03 has no VERIFIES link to any test case, so there is no verification path at all.

2. **URS-EMS-014** (ALARM, FRA-027). The only verifying test case is TC-OQ-EMS-04 (alarm escalation to on-call), and its last passing execution is TX-0070 on SYS-EMS, dated 2026-01-20. That requirement is satisfied through CS-EMS-03, which CC-26-011 modifies (paging provider change, implemented 2026-03-16). The last pass predates the change, and no re-execution is recorded, so the verification is stale.

3. **URS-INC-004** (ALARM, FRA-004). The door-open alarm test TC-OQ-INC-04 failed on INC-03 (TX-0023, 2026-02-10, "Alarm activated at 142 s"). It has not been re-executed on INC-03 since. The linked deviation DEV-26-011 is closed, but CAPA-26-012 (replace the INC-03 door switch and re-execute TC-OQ-INC-04, due 2026-03-31) is still open and overdue. The other three incubators pass, but the requirement applies to every unit in SYS-INC, so it fails.

**Verified, with two caveats (not in the list above)**

- **URS-INC-001 and URS-INC-003** pass on all four incubators. CC-26-019 (door switch replacement on INC-03) is approved but not implemented, and has no implementation date. It cannot be tested for staleness yet, so re-check these two requirements once it is implemented.
- **URS-CRF-001 and URS-PRDG-002** are PERFORMANCE requirements on equipment systems with OQ passes but no PQ evidence. The currently-verified rule does not require PQ, so I counted them as verified, but the PQ-expected rule flags them as a gap.

The remaining verified requirements are URS-EBR-001, -002, -003, -007, -008; URS-EMS-010, -011, -012, -013; URS-LIMS-001 through -006; URS-LOVO-002; URS-PRDG-001; URS-ULT-001 and -002. For URS-ULT-001 and -002, the FRZ-80-02 change (CC-26-014, implemented 2026-04-23) was followed by passing re-executions on 2026-04-24 (TX-0091, TX-0092).
